newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell sharply to 1.7 billion yuan from Tuesday's 2.54 billion yuan with the 90-day contract most active.
Traders said turnover fell sharply with many state banks quitting trading with the approach of the Chinese lunar new year holiday, which begins on February 6.
He said the short-term financial centres, or money brokerages run by the central bank, withdrew from the inter-bank market on Tuesday and would return on February 12 after Lunar New Year.
In the long term, trading would be more active with state banks transferring their funds from the treasury bond markets after having been banned from trading there by the central bank, traders said.
